description: misaka.design public HTML: respect the origin's five-minute Cloudflare TTL
expression: (http.host eq "misaka.design" and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/") and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/about/" "/contact/" "/timeline/" "/wall/"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/blog/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/en/blog/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/projects/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/albums/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/tags/")))
